findings.explanation: HOL4 saves only RESULT (Result t) = t. The definition goes through Prim_rec.new_recursive_definition/new_specification, so the Clash clause is left unspecified (no pattern completion with ARB). Lean sets RESULT (Clash t) = ARB for every t. Because the Nonempty witness is proof-irrelevant, the value does not depend on t, so Lean proves RESULT (Clash a) = RESULT (Clash b) for all a, b (and RESULT (Clash a) = CLASH (Result b)). HOL4 leaves this open: RESULT could, for example, return t on Clash t.
findings.lean_check:
import CandleLean.HolSyntaxLib

theorem chk {α : Type} (a b : α) : Candle.RESULT (Candle.result.Clash a) = Candle.RESULT (Candle.result.Clash b) := rfl

findings.explanation: HOL4 saves only CLASH (Clash t) = t, defined by new_recursive_definition/new_specification, so CLASH (Result t) is left unspecified. Lean sets CLASH (Result t) = ARB for every t, and the Nonempty witness is proof-irrelevant. Lean therefore proves CLASH (Result a) = CLASH (Result b) for all a, b, and CLASH (Result a) = RESULT (Clash b). HOL4 proves neither: CLASH could, for example, return t on Result t.
